```{=html}
<script>
window.FP2_CONFIG = {
  stageId:      'fp2-stage',
  markerClass:  'fp2-slide',
  fragmentIds:  ['fp2-frag-geom', 'fp2-frag-overlay', 'fp2-frag-labs', 'fp2-frag-theme'],
  ticker:       'AAPL',
  geom:         'ohlc',
  overlay:      { type: 'ma', window: 12, color: '#F47C3C' },
  layers:       ['geom', 'overlay', 'labs', 'theme'],
  xDomain:      [0, 119],
  yDomain:      [0, 260],
  xBreaks:      [0, 24, 48, 72, 96, 119],
  yBreaks:      [0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250],
  xMinor:       [12, 36, 60, 84, 108],
  yMinor:       [25, 75, 125, 175, 225],
  colors:       ['#2A4E72', '#B94A48'],
  labs: {
    title: 'AAPL — monthly OHLC',
    x:     'Months since Jan 2015',
    y:     'USD',
    color: ''
  },
  legend:       true,
  legendEntries: [
    { label: 'Up month',   color: '#2A4E72' },
    { label: 'Down month', color: '#B94A48' },
    { label: 'SMA(12)',    color: '#F47C3C', dashed: true }
  ],
  codeHtml:
    '<span data-blk="base"><span class="gg-fn">ggplot</span>(aapl, <span class="gg-fn">aes</span>(date, close)) +</span>\n' +
    '<span data-blk="geom">  <span class="gg-fn">geom_barchart</span>(\n' +
    '    <span class="gg-fn">aes</span>(<span class="gg-arg">open</span> = open, <span class="gg-arg">high</span> = high,\n' +
    '        <span class="gg-arg">low</span> = low, <span class="gg-arg">close</span> = close)) +</span>\n' +
    '<span data-blk="overlay">  <span class="gg-fn">geom_ma</span>(<span class="gg-arg">ma_fun</span> = SMA, <span class="gg-arg">n</span> = <span class="gg-num">12</span>,\n' +
    '          <span class="gg-arg">color</span> = <span class="gg-str">"#F47C3C"</span>) +</span>\n' +
    '<span data-blk="labs">  <span class="gg-fn">labs</span>(<span class="gg-arg">title</span> = <span class="gg-str">"AAPL OHLC"</span>,\n' +
    '       <span class="gg-arg">y</span> = <span class="gg-str">"USD"</span>) +</span>\n' +
    '<span data-blk="theme">  <span class="gg-fn">theme_tq</span>()</span>'
};
</script>
```
